mapper.select: SELECT ya.CORP_GR , ya.JM_CD , ya.JM_NM , ya.JASAN_GB , ya.SEQ_NO , ya.BALH_NATION , ya.CURRENCY , ya.IJA_PER , TO_CHAR(ya.BALH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS balh_ymd , TO_CHAR(ya.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghw_ymd , ya.GYULJE_JM , ya.JASAN_ATTR , ya.SEDOL , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ya.JASAN_GB = '5' ORDER BY ya.JM_CD ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYM0YA ( CORP_GR, JM_CD, JM_NM, JASAN_GB, SEQ_NO, BALH_NATION, CURRENCY, IJA_PER, BALH_YMD, SANGHW_YMD, GYULJE_JM, JASAN_ATTR, SEDOL ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, #{jmNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{jasanGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '5'), #{seqNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{balhNation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ijaPer, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CASE WHEN #{balhYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{balhYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) != '' THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{balhYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) != '' THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{sanghwYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END, COALESCE(#{gyuljeJm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{jasanAttr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sedol, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
